title: Introduce kernel-contention slab metrics and execution fingerprint for per-invocation cost diagnosis
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: We see intermittent bursts in per-invocation token cost and tail latency that current telemetry (per-token counters + span timing) cannot reliably attribute to kernel-level contention (CUDA memcpy/launch stalls, host->device queuing) vs model-side behavior (longer decode loops). This PR introduces a bounded, low-cardinality 'kernel_contention_slab' metric series and a compact per-invocation 'execution_fingerprint' that can be correlated with token-cost/latency to accelerate triage and tune autoscaler/prefetch heuristics.

What this PR does: adds a kernel contention collector in the serving runtime that samples kernel queue depth, last-kernel-latency, and device-memory-io stall ratios and records them into time-series slabs (histogram shards with controlled cardinality). It also computes a 64-bit execution_fingerprint for each invocation by hashing a short execution trace (kernel sequence IDs, batch-size bucket, and quantization profile) and attaches the fingerprint as a tag to traces and metrics. We surface compact fingerprint -> example-trace links in Grafana for quick drilldown.

Design notes: Kept runtime overhead low by: 1) sampling at request-cohort boundaries (prefetch, decode, final_token) rather than per-token; 2) using reservoir-limited slab histograms to avoid high cardinality; 3) emitting a single fingerprint tag per invocation (stringified hex) and a handful of slab metric labels (slab=0..7, device=...) to power aggregated rollups. No unbounded labels. The fingerprint is reversible to a short example trace id stored in a small TTL map in the tracing service to aid human inspection without bloating traces.

Telemetry added (high level): - telemetry/metrics/kernel_contention_slab{slab,device,region} gauge: counts of invocations in contention buckets - telemetry/metrics/last_kernel_ms{device,model} gauge: observed last launched kernel latency per invocation - telemetry/metrics/execution_fingerprint_tag tag emitted on spans and metrics - traces: span annotation "exec.fingerprint" pointing to the trace anchor id - grafana/dashboard/kernel_contention.json: 4 panels (slab distribution, tail correlation to token-cost, top fingerprints by 95th token-cost, time-to-coldstart impact)

APIs and config: introduces two new runtime flags: --obs-kernel-sample-rate (default 1.0 for Dedicated/testing, 0.1 for Hosted) and --exec-fingerprint-ttl (minutes). Configurable by route in the console under observability -> sampling overrides. Default settings chosen to limit signal in large tenants while enabling richer data for Dedicated customers.

Alerts and tuning: Adds a new alert rule 'KernelContentionHigh95' that fires when the 95th percentile of kernel_contention_slab for a route rises above slab 5 for >10m. The rule ties to a runbook that suggests scaling GPU headroom, increasing prefetch workers, or enabling quantization fallbacks. We tuned the alert threshold on historical DAG replay (Linear ENG-6742) to avoid noisy ops.

Files changed (high level): - telemetry/metrics/kernel_collector.go - pkg/serving/runtime/exec_fingerprint.go - observability/dashboards/kernel_contention.json - tracing/span_annotations.pb.go - docs/observability/kernel-contention.md - config/defaults/observability.yaml - tests/integration/kernel_contention_test.go - scripts/grafana/import_kernel_panels.sh - metrics/prometheus/rules/kernel_contention_rule.yaml

Commits summary: - 7b9c2d4 add kernel contention slab collector and unit tests - a1f3b6d wire execution fingerprint into trace/span exporter - 3e4d7f0 add grafana panels and dashboard JSON - 5c8a11e docs and runbook for KernelContentionHigh95 - 9f2d44b integration test to validate slab histograms and tag propagation

Testing and rollout: unit tests cover slab bucket mapping and fingerprint collision windows. Integration tests run end-to-end in perf-lab with controlled synthetic kernel stalls to validate correlation signals. We feature-flagged the change; rollout plan: enable at 5% traffic for Hosted for 48 hours, validate spikes, then ramp to 25%/75% and full. Dedicated clusters default to enabled at 10% sample rate so customers get faster diagnosis.

Backward compatibility & costs: No changes to public API. The execution_fingerprint is an optional tag only emitted when the feature flag/sample rate is enabled. Metrics are emitted at low cardinality and use existing Prometheus/Grafana ingestion pipelines. Estimated telemetry cost + storage impact: +0.6% token-metric cardinality for large tenants (benchmarked) with overall storage delta <2% in retention window.

Related: ENG-6742 (investigate token-cost spikes), ENG-6801 (prefetch heuristics).

Follow-ups we plan: - Add a small UI in Console to list top fingerprints for a time window and link to an example trace - Add automated suggestion engine to map fingerprint -> remediation (scale/prefetch/quantization) - Expand sampling heuristics based on route SLA
